title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in e4jvikwp…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS versions up to and including 1.8.20. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute malicious scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
